metadata.question: Does the agricultural land around Peoria, Illinois show more brown fields in October 2022 compared to September 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Peoria, Illinois (approximately 40.69°N, 89.59°W) - Need to define a region around Peoria for agricultural analysis - Date ranges: September 2022 and October 2022 - Collection: Sentinel-2 (high resolution, good for vegetation), with Landsat as fallback 2. Masking strategy: - Should mask clouds since we're looking at vegetation/brown fields - Need clear imagery to assess field colors 3. Logic for brown fields: - Brown fields = senescent/harvested vegetation = lower NDVI and lower greenness - Compare mean NDVI or green band intensity between September and October - Lower values in October = more brown = Answer A - Higher or similar values in October = Answer B - Need to distinguish valid decrease from null/error (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry around Peoria, Illinois const peoria = ee.Geometry.Point([-89.59, 40.69]); const aoi = peoria.buffer(15000); // 15km radius for agricultural areas // 2. Define date ranges const sept2022 = ee.DateRange('2022-09-01', '2022-09-30'); const oct2022 = ee.DateRange('2022-10-01', '2022-10-31'); // 3. Load Sentinel-2 collection with cloud masking function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask).divide(10000); } // 4. Get September data let septCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(sept2022.start(), sept2022.end()) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) .map(maskS2clouds); let septSize = septCol.size().getInfo(); console.log('September 2022 Images:', septSize); // Fallback to Landsat 8 if Sentinel-2 unavailable if (septSize === 0) { console.log('Trying Landsat 8 for September...'); septCol = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(sept2022.start(), sept2022.end()) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); septSize = septCol.size().getInfo(); console.log('Landsat September Images:', septSize); } if (septSize === 0) { console.log('No data for September 2022.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Get October data let octCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(oct2022.start(), oct2022.end()) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) .map(maskS2clouds); let octSize = octCol.size().getInfo(); console.log('October 2022 Images:', octSize); // Fallback to Landsat 8 if Sentinel-2 unavailable if (octSize === 0) { console.log('Trying Landsat 8 for October...'); octCol = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate(oct2022.start(), oct2022.end()) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); octSize = octCol.size().getInfo(); console.log('Landsat October Images:', octSize); } if (octSize === 0) { console.log('No data for October 2022.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 6. Calculate NDVI for both periods function addNDVI(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } const septImage = septCol.map(addNDVI).median(); const octImage = octCol.map(addNDVI).median(); // 7. Get statistics const septStats = septImage.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: aoi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const octStats = octImage.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: aoi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const septNDVI = septStats.get('NDVI_mean').getInfo(); const septCount = septStats.get('NDVI_count').getInfo(); const octNDVI = octStats.get('NDVI_mean').getInfo(); const octCount = octStats.get('NDVI_count').getInfo(); console.log('September NDVI:', septNDVI, 'Pixels:', septCount); console.log('October NDVI:', octNDVI, 'Pixels:', octCount); // 8. Validation and answer if (septCount === 0 || octCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (septNDVI === null || octNDVI === null || isNaN(septNDVI) || isNaN(octNDVI)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid NDVI values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (septNDVI > 1 || octNDVI > 1 || septNDVI < -1 || octNDVI < -1) { console.log('Invalid NDVI range detected.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Lower NDVI in October means more brown/senescent vegetation const ndviDecrease = septNDVI - octNDVI; console.log('NDVI Decrease (Sept to Oct):', ndviDecrease.toFixed(4)); if (ndviDecrease > 0.05) { console.log('Significant decrease in NDVI - more brown fields in October.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('No significant increase in brown fields.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
